# S58 — Provide a simple install path without cloning the repository

Make slicer easy to install for casual users who do not want to clone the repository, while retaining the documented clone-based/editable workflow.

**Findings:** user request: easier installation for casual users while retaining clone-based installs · **Size:**  · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** removing or breaking clone-based/editable installation, assuming a distribution channel or platform support before agreeing the design, or publishing a release without owner authorization.

## Why

The current install documentation starts with a repository clone, virtual environment, and editable install. Casual users need an approachable installation path that does not require a checkout. Contributors and users who prefer a checkout must retain the existing path.

## Implement

Agree on the supported platforms, distribution channel, prerequisites, and install/update/uninstall experience before implementation. Document a simple no-clone path alongside the existing clone-based editable install, with clear guidance about which path to choose.

Ensure each supported installation includes all runtime content, including templates and the built-in AI onboarding instructions. Instructions may remain embedded in code or use a bundled Markdown resource; either representation must be available without a source checkout.

Related work: S06 is the parked PyPI publication item; coordinate with it if PyPI is selected rather than duplicating release work. S57 supplies the agent onboarding command. No distribution choice or dependency is implied by these references.
